text: The Evolution and Regulation of Venture Capital Funds should be assessed against Kaal's source-bound claim that ICO issuance exceeded venture capital financing of startups for the first time in the second quarter of 2017, with $210 million invested through ICOs against $180 million invested through traditional venture capital funds.
